Presolicitation Notice/Advertisement RLP Procurement Summary    

GSA Public Buildings Service

U.S. GOVERNMENT

General Services Administration (GSA) seeks to lease the following space:

State: Illinois

City: Alton

Delineated Area:

  • Northern boundary: IL-255, IL-111, Airport Road
  • Western Boundary: Pierce Lane, Dellmar Ave, State Street, Hwy 67, Hwy 143, Lewis and Clark Blvd
  • Southern boundary: Hwy 143
  • Eastern Boundary: Hwy 255, Vaughn Rd, Edwardsville Rd, 9th Street, Airline, Hwy 255

Minimum Sq. Ft. (ABOA): 4,941

Maximum Sq. Ft. (ABOA): 5,189

Space Type: Office

Parking Spaces (Total): Parking-to-square-foot ratio available on-site shall at least meet current local code requirements

Parking Spaces (Surface): 0

Parking Spaces (Structured): 0

Parking Spaces (Reserved): 0

Full Term: 15 years- Please see below

Firm Term: 10 years- Please see below

Option Term: N/A

Additional Requirements:

  • Important Note: The offeror must have 1,000 -2,500 SF of space available for Government use effective 12/2026. 
  • Parking-to-square-foot ratio available on-site shall at least meet current local code requirements
  • Space must be located in a prime commercial office district with attractive surroundings with a prevalence of modern design and/or tasteful rehabilitation in modern use.
  • Offered space must be located in contiguous space and on one floor.
  • Offered Space shall allow for an accessible main public entrance and an accessible separate employee entrance as part of the shell rate.
  • Employee and visitor entrances of the Building must be connected to public sidewalks or street by continuous, accessible sidewalks.
  • If space offered is above ground level, at least two (2) accessible elevators will be required.
  • The Government will have access to the space 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.  Normal hours of operation are Monday through Friday 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. (excluding Saturdays, Sundays and Federal Holidays).

Offered space must meet Government requirements for fire safety, accessibility, seismic, and sustainability standards per the terms of the Lease.  A fully serviced lease is required.  Offered space shall not be in the 1-percent-annual chance floodplain (formerly referred to as “100-year” floodplain).

Entities are advised to familiarize themselves with the telecommunications prohibitions outlined under Section 889 of the FY19 National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), as implemented by the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR).  For more information, visit: https://acquisition.gov/FAR-Case-2019-009/889_Part_B.

Expressions of Interest Due: May 11, 2026

Market Survey (Estimated): May 2026

Occupancy (Estimated): October 2026

Send Expressions of Interest to:

Name/Title: Clarissa Mahoney

Email Address: Clarissa.mahoney@gsa.gov

Government Contact Information

Lease Contracting Officer: Alanna Fitzpatrick

Broker: Clarissa Mahoney

******************************************************************************************************

Note:   Entities not currently registered in the System for Award Management (SAM.gov) are advised to start the registration process as soon as possible.

Solicitation Number:

Solicitation (RLP) Number: 0IL2403
